Overview:

This position offers you the opportunity to work with public agency IT teams of Singapore to support their IT digitization strategy and roadmap. If you are driven by challenges and passionate about working with cutting-edge IT technology, come chat with us to see if this role is a good fit for your career aspirations. 

What will you be doing?

You will be working within an agency as part of its IT project team, which includes the Product/Project Manager, Solution Architect, and, where applicable, a Technical Services Consultant. Together, you will deliver ICT capabilities to support Singapore’s vision of a Smart Nation.

We look for people who value agility, passion, and teamwork; those who can bring fresh ideas to the table and want the opportunity to learn, grow, and expand their careers. Bring your aptitude and build upon what you do best for our customers, partners, team, and you.

Experience & Skills Required:
Experience: 3-7years
Key Responsibilities:
Design and develop full-stack web applications using:
Frontend: React, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5/CSS3
Backend: Java with Spring Boot, microservices, and RESTful APIs
Work with SQL Server/Azure SQL Database for relational data, adapting to other databases (NoSQL, etc.) as project needs dictate.
Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines(DevOps) and implement secure coding practices.
Deploy and manage cloud-native solutions (AWS Lambda, S3, Docker) and containerized applications.
Ensure code quality through automated testing(Selenium, Mocha, Karma) and peer reviews.
Collaborate with Product Managers, QA, and UI/UX teams in Agile/SCRUM environments.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical roadmaps and architecture decisions.
Education: Bachelor's degree or above

If you are looking for an opportunity to grow your career while working on meaningful projects, we would love to hear from you!

 

 

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

Why AvePoint?

We are invested in the success of our colleagues, partners, customers, and community. We do this by promoting global collaboration and taking pride in helping, sharing, mentoring, and coaching each other.
